subject: Post-call: Executive recap & next steps — Cardinal Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@cardinalhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Executive recap & next steps — Cardinal Health

Hi Emily / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick executive recap from our discussion and agreed next steps so leadership has a single place to reference.

Key business outcomes you called out:
- Accelerate clinical documentation workflows to reduce clinician time spent on admin tasks (target 25–30% reduction in first 6 months).
- Reduce downstream transcription / QA costs by consolidating NLU pipeline into a single inference layer.
- Protect PHI and meet enterprise controls for payment/contracting.

Top pain points discussed:
- Bursty peak loads during end-of-quarter reporting creating latency spikes.
- Current vendor lock and poor visibility into token-level costs.
- Security assurance gap: SOC 2 artifacts, key management, and contractual security language.

What Redwood can bring immediately:
- Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and isolation (can be deployed in your VPC for PHI workloads).
- Cost & latency observability (token-level dashboards + alerts).
- SOC 2 summary and audit evidence (attached) + optional private deployment for regulated workflows.

Procurement & legal path (as discussed):
1) Procurement kickoff + intake (Rajiv) — we provide MSA + preliminary SOW.
2) Security review (legal & infosec) — we’ll provide SOC 2 summary, architecture diagram, and data flow.
3) Executive review for business case & budget (Emily) — target decision point: internal exec review week of 10/25.

Risks / open items:
- Need clarity on data residency for a subset of PHI data (you noted some workloads may require on-prem or restricted region).
- Pricing is ballpark until we confirm average vs. peak token throughput.

Agreed next steps & owners:
- I’ll send a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and a preliminary SOW by EOD today. (Action: Marissa)
- Rajiv to confirm preferred contracting model (PO vs. MSA + SOW) and internal timeline. (Action: Rajiv)
- Emily to share internal exec review date and any additional stakeholders. (Action: Emily)

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx, redwood_1pager.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up with procurement + legal if that helps speed review.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

---

From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Executive recap & next steps — Cardinal Health

Thanks Marissa — solid recap and appreciate the clear next steps.

Two immediate asks from my side:
1) We need SOC 2 Type II evidence (or a summary) and any information on key management (KMS/HSM) options. PHI is a blocker for a number of our stakeholders.
2) High-level pricing bands for dedicated capacity vs hosted API so finance can ballpark.

Rajiv — looping you in to confirm procurement cadence; happy to schedule an internal exec review for the week of 10/25 once we have the MAP and pricing.

Emily
SVP, Digital Transformation
Cardinal Health

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@cardinalhealth.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 17:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Executive recap & next steps — Cardinal Health

Emily — thanks, noted.

Quick follow up items (attached):
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf — 2-page summary of SOC 2 controls and last audit date. Full artifact can be provided under NDA / secure share.
- MAP_v1.xlsx — proposed milestones and owners.
- redwood_1pager.pdf — high-level offering overview and quick pricing bands.

High-level pricing (very rough until we confirm throughput):
- Hosted API (cloud): $0.045–$0.08 per 1k tokens (varies by model tier + streaming).
- Dedicated capacity (reserved / VPC): starting at ~$25k/month for small pool (predictable throughput) scaling to commitments for enterprise.

On the PHI / KMS question: we support customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers, and our Private deployment option supports on-prem or VPC-hosted control plane for regulated workloads.

Proposed exec review: Thu 10/21 or Mon 10/25 — which works better for your team?

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, MAP_v1.xlsx, redwood_1pager.pdf

Onward — I’ll also surface a preliminary SOW for procurement.

Best,
Marissa

---

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Legal <legal@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Executive recap & next steps — Cardinal Health

Thanks Marissa / Emily —

Couple of procurement questions to help us shape timeline:
1) Do you have a standard MSA we can review, and would you accept a PO against a signed SOW?
2) We’ll need an initial SOW that outlines deliverables, volumes, SLAs, and support terms for the pilot (60–90 day).
3) Security team will send a questionnaire; please confirm who on your side will own responses and estimated turnaround.

Timeline we’re aiming for: internal procurement + legal review complete by 11/12 so we can onboard pilot before year-end.

Rajiv Menon
Director, Procurement
Cardinal Health

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@cardinalhealth.com>, Emily Stone <emily.stone@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Executive recap & next steps — Cardinal Health

Rajiv — great questions. Short answers below and then I’ve added links and attachments.

1) Standard MSA: Yes — we’ll circulate our standard MSA for review. We can accept a PO against a signed SOW depending on internal approvals; I’ll confirm with legal and note acceptance policy.
2) SOW: attaching a preliminary SOW (prelim_sow_draft.pdf) that outlines pilot scope, success criteria, rough volumes, and suggested SLAs. This is intended to speed procurement and will be editable.
3) Security questionnaire: Rishi Malhotra (cc’d) will own the questionnaire response and coordinate with our security team. Expect a first-pass response within 3–5 business days of receiving the questionnaire.

Links:
- Deal record & MAP: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-2027-CH-0421
- Preview SOW / DocuSign session: https://app.docusign.com/sessions/abcdef123456

Proposed next step: procurement + legal sync on Fri 10/22 at 11:00am ET — open to a different time if that conflicts.

Attachments: prelim_sow_draft.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar invite and updated MAP after internal alignment.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
